# Save current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
def get_ring_colors(seg):
    colors = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            r = min(row for row, col in b)
            c = min(col for row, col in b)
            colors[(r,c)] = n['color']
    return colors

before = get_ring_colors(current_frame.segmentation)

# Test (34,19)
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 34, 'col': 19}])

print(f"(34,19) changed {len(changed)} tiles:")
for k, v in sorted(changed.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v[0]}→{v[1]}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Undo by clicking (34,44)
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 34, 'col': 44}])

print(f"\n(34,44) changed {len(changed2)} tiles:")

    print(f"  {k}: {v[0]}→{v[1]}")
